question: 回答图片中的问题。如果是选择题，请提供你认为正确的选项。如果是简答题，请提供你的答案。

steps.description: Identify the pattern type shown in the question stem graphic
Examine the first row and determine the operation result between shaded and white elements
Examine the second row and determine the operation result between shaded and white elements
Compare the operation results from the first and second rows to identify the pattern
Analyze the first column to identify the operation rule when both elements are white
Analyze the first column to identify the operation rule when both elements are shaded
Analyze the first column to identify the operation rule when one element is shaded and the other is white
Analyze the first column to identify the operation rule when one element is white and the other is shaded
Verify whether the second column follows the same operation rules established in the first column
Apply the identified operation rules to determine the result for the third column
Match the calculated result with the provided options to select the correct answer
